body:
i will never get over this one 🫒

reputation tour, opening night — glendale, may 2018. taylor walks into her dressing room and finds an actual olive branch waiting for her.

it came with a handwritten note from katy perry. the first line? "hello old friend."

four years of the most-talked-about feud in pop — the one everyone tied to "bad blood" — quietly ended right there, backstage. "this means so much," taylor said from her dressing room. "thank you katy."

a year later they'd stand side by side in the "you need to calm down" video. this was the moment it turned.

tag the friend you're so glad you made up with.
